confidence.notes: Verified on hardware (firmware 3133, part 006-B4062-00): the map renders, mixed-case Swiss labels are correct, and DEM shaded relief DOES render -- though it is too dark/contrasty at 1 arc-second in alpine terrain. GarminDevice.xml advertises Garmin/CustomMaps and Garmin/BirdsEye directories, which contradicts the common claim that Edge devices cannot take raster maps; unproven, but worth investigating for raster fidelity. NOT measured: maxImgBytes, maxTilesPerMapset. See docs/device-verification.md B.
